intro: THE WAAAGH! FILLS THE SKY WITH SHIPS AND FIRE.
THE STEEL LEGION BLEEDS ON EVERY FRONT.
COMMISSAR YARRICK COORDINATES THE DEFENCE FROM WHAT REMAINS.
BUT THE ORKS POUR THROUGH EVERY GAP.
THE MANUFACTORUM HAS FALLEN. THE FUNGAL CAVES CHOKE WITH MONSTERS.
STRIKE INTO THE WAAAGH!'S HEART BEFORE ARMAGEDDON IS LOST.
YOUR CONTACT IN THE STEEL LEGION GAVE YOU ONE INSTRUCTION:
THEY DID NOT SPECIFY HOW. THEY TRUSTED YOU TO FIGURE IT OUT.
midpoint: THE MANUFACTORUM IS SILENT. THE MACHINES ARE STILL.
MAD DOK GROTSNIK KEPT RECORDS. ORKS KEEP RECORDS. WHO KNEW.
THE SCHEMATICS ARE UNMISTAKABLE: A GARGANT.
A WAR ENGINE THE SIZE OF A HIVE BLOCK.
IT WAS SUPPOSED TO BE COMPLETED IN THREE DAYS.
BUT GROTSNIK'S OTHER NOTES ARE WORSE.
GHAZGHKULL HAS SENT COORDINATES INTO THE WARP.
MORE WARBANDS. MORE WAAAGHS. DRAWN TO ARMAGEDDON.
THE IRON FORTRESS IS WHERE HE WAITS.
YOU KNOW WHAT YOU HAVE TO DO.
YOU KNOW IT WON'T BE EASY.
before_final_boss: GHAZGHKULL SPEAKS FROM HIS IRON THRONE:
'YA KILLED ME BOYZ. YA KILLED ME DOK. YA BURNED ME CAMP.'
'DAT'S DA BEST FIGHT I'VE 'AD IN FREE MILLENNIA.'
'DA EMPEROR'S LADZ AIN'T SO SOFT AFTER ALL!'
'NOW COME. SHOW GHAZGHKULL WOT YA'VE GOT.'
ending_choice: THE WAAAGH! FALTERS. THE ORKS LOOK TO EACH OTHER.
WITHOUT HIM DIRECTING IT, THE INVASION LOSES COHERENCE.
BUT GHAZGHKULL IS NOT DEAD. NOT YET.
OR DO YOU LET ARMAGEDDON'S DEFENDERS CLAIM THE HONOUR?
